$comment: #EXP-2172 THE CI PAGE AS ONE genUI TREE, the same on every platform (ci-page.json says what; this pins HOW, node for node). A case: `world` (`scenario` = ci-page.json's scenario; `empty` = it without runs, jobs, pull requests and runners), `tab` (runs | train | runners), `filter` {status, repositoryId, source} (null = All), `phone` → `tree` (A2UI nested nodes: id, component, props, children, slots, on). Only the current tab's panel is built (the others are empty stacks); the platform adds its own page chrome (title, back) and maps the events: ci-tab / ci-filter-status / ci-filter-repo / ci-filter-source carry the control's value (`all` = no filter), ci-open-run {run} (the Table's rowPress carries the row), ci-open-pr {pr}, ci-open-runner {device}. The runner row's offline meta is a `fill` + `formatRelativeTime` call the renderer evaluates. The reference is apps/web/src/lib/ci-page-view.ts (its test replays this file); desktop, iOS and Android build the same trees. Regenerate after a deliberate change with `bun apps/web/scripts/bless-ci-page-view.ts` and review the diff.
